column2: AN ACT TO AMEND THE EXCISE ORDINANCE (CHAPTER 52)

column1: BE it enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic Socialist
Republic of Sri Lanka as follows :—

column2: (1) This Act may be cited as the Excise (Amendment)
(2) The  provisions  of  this Act  shall  for  all  purposes  be

column1: deemed to have come into operation on November 19, 2010.

column2: Section 15 of the Excise Ordinance (Chapter 52) is

column1: hereby amended by the repeal of paragraphs (b) and (c) of

column2: no tree producing toddy, other than the kithul tree
and the palmyrah tree, shall be tapped ; and
no toddy shall be drawn from any tree, other than
the kithul tree and the palmayrah tree.”.
In the event of any inconsistency between the Sinhala

column1: and Tamil texts of this Act, the Sinhala text shall prevail.
